insurer: ADITYA BIRLA HEALTH INSURANCE CO. LIMITED

room_rent.note: Base plan covers actuals up to Sum Insured. Optional add-on allows downgrade to Single Private Room or Shared Accommodation.

icu.note: ICU/ICCU charges covered at actuals up to Sum Insured.

copayment.note: No mandatory co-pay on base plan. If PPN Discount optional cover is opted, a 10% co-pay applies when treatment is taken outside the Preferred Provider Network.

sub_limits.note: All in-patient benefits covered at actuals up to Sum Insured. Chronic Care optional cover has a combined sub-limit of ₹5L or SI whichever is lower.

deductible.note: No deductible on base plan. Per Claim Deductible is an optional cover with options of ₹15,000 or ₹25,000 per claim.

initial_waiting.note: Standard 30-day initial waiting period; not applicable for accidents.

ped_waiting.note: Base PED waiting period is 36 months. Reducible via optional 'Reduction in Pre-Existing Disease Waiting Period' add-on.

specific_disease_waiting.note: Standard specific disease/procedure waiting period is 24 months. Reducible to 12 months via optional 'Reduction in Specific Disease Waiting Period' add-on.

maternity.note: Maternity expenses are excluded under standard exclusion Excl18, except ectopic pregnancy.

cumulative_bonus.note: No inbuilt cumulative/no-claim bonus in the traditional sense. Super Credit is an optional cover that increases SI by a fixed % each year irrespective of claims, up to 100% of Base SI.

restoration.note: Super Reload is inbuilt. Triggers when Base SI + Super Credit is exhausted. Available unlimited times per year, each reload equals Base SI. First claim: 2x cover; 2nd claim onwards: unlimited refills.

pre_hosp.note: Pre-hospitalisation expenses covered for up to 90 days prior to hospitalisation.

post_hosp.note: Post-hospitalisation expenses covered for up to 180 days from date of discharge.

day_care.note: All day-care treatments covered at actuals up to Sum Insured.

domiciliary.note: Domiciliary hospitalisation covered if treatment continues for at least 3 consecutive days and patient cannot be moved or no hospital room is available.

ayush.note: AYUSH in-patient treatment covered at actuals up to Sum Insured in recognised AYUSH hospitals or day care centres.

organ_donor.note: Organ donor hospitalisation expenses for harvesting covered up to SI, subject to recipient's claim being admissible. Pre/post-hospitalisation of donor excluded.

ambulance.note: Road ambulance (domestic only) covered at actuals up to Sum Insured per hospitalisation for emergency transfer or hospital-to-home.

modern_treatments.note: Listed modern procedures (robotic surgery, oral chemotherapy, stereotactic radio surgery, deep brain stimulation, etc.) covered at actuals up to Sum Insured.

consumables.note: Non-medical/consumable expenses (all 4 lists in Annexure I) are excluded by default. Covered if 'Claim Protect (Non-Medical Expense Waiver)' optional cover is purchased.

global_cover.display: Not covered (base); optional Global cover available
global_cover.note: Treatment outside India is excluded by default (D.2.8). Global Enhanced and Global Cover (Emergency Only) are referenced as optional covers in the policy.

moratorium.note: After 60 continuous months of coverage (including portability/migration), no claim can be contested except on grounds of established fraud.

grace_period.note: Grace period is 15 days for monthly premium payment mode and 30 days for all other modes.

free_look.note: 30-day free-look period from date of receipt of policy document. Applicable on new individual policies only; not on renewals or portability.

portability.note: Portability to other insurers allowed as per IRDAI guidelines, with continuity of waiting periods and moratorium.

notable_exclusions.display: Maternity (except ectopic), sterility/IVF, dental (except accident), refractive error <7.5D, specific treatments (RFQMR, EECP, Cyber Knife, Femto Laser), treatment outside India (base)

optional_riders.display: Claim Protect (consumables), PED waiting reduction, Specific disease waiting reduction (1yr), Per Claim Deductible, PPN Discount, Critical Illness, Personal Accident, Super Credit, Chronic Care, Cancer Booster, Durable Equipment, Global Cover
